style_en: Miniature diorama 3D CG render in an empty white space. Smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details). Soft shadows, slightly high camera angle. Mostly white and gray, only key objects in red. Vertical phone frame: keep the top 35% of the frame as plain background with no heads or key objects; place the main subject between 35% and 68% of the height.
avoid_en: logos or emblems of real companies or government agencies, readable text, detailed national flags, blood, faces resembling real people
